name: Noah Austin
tagline: Debater, aspiring rationalist, and seeker of first principles.
about: I'm a 10th Grader at UWC determined to understand the world around me. Be it the phenomenon I see or the arguments of my friends, I strive to go deeper and push myself to understand.

activities.title: Forum Leader
activities.description: Forum is a student-led platform for discourse where the next generation of thinkers analyze and debate the complex geopolitical and economic forces shaping our world.

activities.title: Debate Team
activities.description: Engaged in competitive debate in WSDC, AP, and BP formats internationally.

activities.title: Volunteer with Indochina Starfish Foundation
activities.description: Volunteer with Indochina Starfish Foundation, a non-profit organization that provides education and support to children in need.

activities.title: Model Philosophy Ethics Olympiad
activities.description: Two time podium finisher at international Ethics Olympiad, a dialectal competition dedicated to truth seeking and philosophical discourse.

activities.title: Theatre
activities.description: Actively involved in theatre, both on and off stage, having played leading roles in multiple productions.

activities.title: Economics & Business Intern
activities.description: Redesigned Grade 9 and 10 course frameworks, co-authored instructional workbooks for the IBDP Economics syllabus, and engineered revision clinics to diagnose conceptual bottlenecks and facilitate academic success.

achievements.title: 2025 English Language & Literature Academic Award
achievements.detail: Top 2 Students of >300. Awarded for excellence in English Language & Literature and exemplary modelling of the values of a UWC student.

achievements.title: Academic Commendations
achievements.detail: Recognised for outstanding performance in Economics, Additional Science, Drama & Design, and Physical Education.

achievements.title: Singapore Silver National Youth Achievement Award
achievements.detail: Recognised for sustained committment to service and leadership. Awarded following a year of service and contribution to the community..

achievements.title: Honors in Global Economics @ Phillips Exeter Academy
achievements.detail: Recognised as 'undisputed leader' and commended for excellence at the Harkness table by Dr. Eric Bowman.
